Amazon's fall Prime Day early deals have officially kicked off, and beyond a slate of fresh discounts, there's a brand-new Mac Studio for $50 off, up to $150 off various M5 MacBook Air models, and we've also spotted a $500 discount on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro (in Space Black and Silver), ongoing clearance deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 3, a massive selection of TV deals, and fresh accessory discounts from brands like Twelve South and Anker. Here's everything you need to know.

Amazon has $500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro in Space Black and Silver

While there are still plenty of worthwhile deals on the latest M5 MacBook Air models, we wanted to circle back to the $500 discount Amazon is offering on this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro — both the Space Black and Silver configurations are now available at this deep discount.

Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch MacBook Pro with the M5 Pro chip, 24GB of RAM, and 2TB of storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

This is the lowest price we've recorded in the past several months, and the offer applies to both the Space Black and Silver models — the Silver version is typically discounted less often.

That's $500 off the $3,199 list price. As mentioned before, many tech deals right now are just bringing prices back down to the original MSRP, but this deal is $100 cheaper than even before Apple's price hike in late June.

All-time best deal on 15-inch M5 MacBook Air is $100 off, and $150 off the 24GB version

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB: $1,449 (was $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB: $1,399 (was $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB: $1,849 (was $1,999)

Rare clearance deals on the Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 in small and medium sizes, with up to $200 off select models

While the brand-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 has officially launched with launch-day deals across several configurations, Amazon is also running multiple deals on the previous-generation — but still very capable — Apple Watch Ultra 3 at prices far below the Ultra 4.

The Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the Milanese Loop is the most enticing deal of the bunch — originally $899, it's now available with close to a $200 discount. It's arguably the standout of this clearance event, though other configurations have also joined the discount lineup this morning.

One thing to note: other configurations are now priced the same as the Milanese Loop version mentioned above. But the nearly $200 discount only applies to the large size, while the medium and small sizes are $100 off on select models — these popular medium sizes rarely see deals like this:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Alpine Loop: $699 (was $799) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop: $799 (was $899) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Trail Loop: $699 (was $799) | Small

Again, the large Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop remains the best value, but given how rare medium-size deals tend to be, we felt it deserved a special mention.

Here are some of the more modest launch-day deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 4:

Apple's brand-new 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio is $50 off at Amazon

Beyond the return of launch-day early deals on the more affordable M6 Mac mini, those looking to pick up the beefier 2026 Mac Studio that Apple launched earlier can also find a new low price at Amazon.

Amazon is currently selling the brand-new Mac Studio with the M5 Max chip, 36GB of RAM, and 512GB of storage for $2,449 with free shipping.

That's $50 off the $2,499 list price right out of the gate. It's not a massive discount, but for anyone looking to upgrade early, $50 in your pocket is better than nothing — and it's also $1 cheaper than the preorder deal.

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB: $2,450 (was $2,499)

Since Amazon never officially carried the previous Mac Studio configurations, it's hard to predict how discounts on this new machine will trend. For now, the launch-day early deal is similar to what we've seen on the new M6 Mac mini, but Amazon typically discounts aggressively during the early period of new Apple product launches, so it's unclear whether this pro-level machine will see further markdowns during Prime Day and Black Friday. It could potentially drop by around $100 by year's end, but that's still up in the air for now.

Either way, early adopters can pocket some cash, and those who don't need the raw power of the M5 Max with 36GB of RAM can also check out the following M6 Mac mini configurations, where previous deals have returned:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB: $880 (was $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB: $1,070 (was $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB: $1,270 (was $1,299)

Some products are even cheaper at Amazon than on the official website, while others are only discounted on the official site.
